planets.name: Earth
planets.description: Cradle of humanity. A lush, temperate world teeming with life and the heart of the gate network.

planets.name: Mars
planets.description: The Red Planet. Dusty basins and ancient riverbeds hint at a warmer past. Early terraforming efforts are underway.

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.description: A colossal gas giant ringed by dozens of moons. Its radiation belts shelter vast fuel-harvesting platforms.

planets.name: Haven
planets.description: A windswept terrestrial world with shallow seas and fertile plains. The most promising colony site beyond Sol.

planets.name: Dustfall
planets.description: Rust-colored deserts stretch beneath twin suns. Rich in accessible surface ores.

planets.name: Shardring Belt
planets.description: A dense ring of shattered planetesimals. Mining operations here would yield significant metal output.

anomalies.description: Faint repeating signal detected from within the Shardring Belt. Origin unknown.

planets.name: Pelagius
planets.description: An oceanic paradise blanketed by warm, shallow seas. Bioluminescent organisms light the endless waves at night. Highly suitable for colonization.

planets.name: Typhon
planets.description: A roiling blue-green gas giant with supersonic equatorial winds and a spectacular ring system.

anomalies.description: Sonar mapping of Pelagius reveals geometric structures on the ocean floor. Pre-human construction suspected.

planets.name: Cinder
planets.description: A scorched husk orbiting close to the dim red dwarf. No atmosphere remains.

anomalies.description: Spectral analysis of the inner asteroid field reveals extraordinarily dense metallic concentrations. A miner's dream.

planets.name: Inferno
planets.description: Rivers of magma crisscross this hellish world. Exotic crystalline deposits form in the cooling lava tubes, making it a prime harvesting target.

planets.name: Ashveil
planets.description: A dead, cratered world permanently shrouded in fine silicate dust. Little of value remains on the surface.

anomalies.description: Sirius A emits violent stellar flares at irregular intervals. Ships in-system risk radiation damage without proper shielding.

planets.name: Arcadia
planets.description: Rolling grasslands and temperate forests cover most of this world. Thick atmosphere retains warmth despite the cooler star. An excellent colony candidate.

planets.name: Ferros
planets.description: A dense, iron-rich planet with towering mountain ranges. The heavy gravity is challenging but the mineral wealth is staggering.

anomalies.description: Orbital debris of clearly artificial origin drifts between the two planets. Someone was here before us.

planets.name: Frostholme
planets.description: A frozen world locked in eternal winter. Beneath kilometers of ice, thermal vents hint at a subsurface ocean and possible microbial life.

anomalies.description: A rhythmic energy pulse emanates from deep within Frostholme's ice mantle. The pattern is too regular to be natural.

planets.name: Goliath
planets.description: An enormous banded gas giant three times Jupiter's mass. Its upper atmosphere is a virtually limitless source of starship fuel.

planets.name: Anchorage
planets.description: A small, airless moon of Goliath. Its stable orbit and low gravity make it an ideal site for a fuel depot and waystation.

anomalies.description: A continent-sized storm on Goliath emits unusual electromagnetic signatures that interfere with standard scanning equipment.

planets.name: Luminara
planets.description: A blindingly bright world bathed in Vega's intense radiation. Exotic matter crystallizes naturally on its surface in vast glittering fields.

planets.name: The Sentinel
planets.description: Not a planet at all, but an enormous ancient structure in stable orbit. Its purpose is unknown. Faint power readings suggest it is not entirely dead.

anomalies.description: The Sentinel emits a low-frequency carrier wave on a bandwidth no human technology uses. Deep-pattern analysis suggests it may be a beacon or a warning.
Surface probes on Luminara have detected a partially buried object of non-natural origin. Its material composition matches nothing in known databases.

planets.name: Geminus Alpha
planets.description: The larger world in a binary star system. Dual sunrises paint the sky in vivid oranges. Habitable but geologically unstable.

planets.name: Geminus Beta
planets.description: Tidally locked between both stars, one hemisphere is molten slag while the other is frozen wasteland. Valuable minerals line the terminator zone.

anomalies.description: Instruments detect gravitational fluctuations inconsistent with the binary pair. A hidden mass or spatial distortion may exist in the outer system.

planets.name: Whisper
planets.description: A quiet, temperate world orbiting a placid red dwarf. Atmospheric analysis reveals trace compounds of possible biological origin.

planets.name: Echo
planets.description: A barren outer planet. Its surface is scored with perfectly parallel grooves visible from orbit, stretching for thousands of kilometers.

anomalies.description: A complex, structured radio signal originates from somewhere within the Ross 128 system. It does not match any known natural phenomenon or human transmission protocol.
The parallel grooves on Echo are precisely 128 meters apart and exactly 12.8 meters deep. The mathematical regularity defies geological explanation.

planets.name: Remnant
planets.description: An ancient, cratered world that may be older than Sol itself. Its rocks contain exotic isotopes not found elsewhere in the network.

planets.name: Threshold
planets.description: A small, dark body at the system's edge. Orbital analysis suggests it was deliberately placed in a Lagrange point eons ago.

anomalies.description: Scattered across Remnant's surface are the shattered remains of what appears to be a massive gate hub complex, far larger than any single gate. This system may once have been a nexus of an interstellar civilization.
Beyond the outermost orbit, sensors detect a faint boundary where the fabric of space seems to thin. The edge of the gate network, or something else entirely.

efficient_drives.name: Efficient Drives
efficient_drives.description: Improve fuel efficiency for all ships by 20%

gate_resonance.name: Gate Resonance Tuning
gate_resonance.description: Reduce gate activation energy cost by 30%

burst_drives.name: Burst Acceleration
burst_drives.description: +1 speed for Scout and Corvette classes

long_range_drives.name: Long-Range Drives
long_range_drives.description: Improve fuel efficiency for all ships by 40%

slipstream_calibration.name: Slipstream Calibration
slipstream_calibration.description: Reduce gate activation energy cost by 50%

rapid_construction.name: Rapid Construction
rapid_construction.description: -1 turn for all ship and building construction

industrial_processing.name: Industrial Processing
industrial_processing.description: Enables ore-to-metals conversion. +30% industry output at colonies

automation_lines.name: Automation Lines
automation_lines.description: -2 turns for ship and building construction

deep_scan.name: Deep Scanning Arrays
deep_scan.description: +1 sensor range for all ships, reveal hidden anomalies

research_acceleration.name: Research Acceleration
research_acceleration.description: Intel synergy: +1 intel per turn per colony with research lab

signal_decryption.name: Signal Decryption
signal_decryption.description: Can decode alien transmissions, unlocking diplomacy events

colonisation.name: Colonisation
colonisation.description: Unlocks founding outposts on colonizable worlds

logistics_1.name: Logistics I
logistics_1.description: Enables trade routes between colonies. Base capacity 10/turn

logistics_2.name: Logistics II
logistics_2.description: Increases route capacity by 50%. Enables logistics hubs

logistics_3.name: Logistics III
logistics_3.description: Doubles route capacity. Enables auto-balancing supply routes

logistics_4.name: Logistics IV
logistics_4.description: Increases route capacity by 150%. Enables rapid auto-balancing.

spaceport.description: Basic orbital docking and storage. Receives ships but cannot build them.

drydock.description: Ship assembly facility. Can build scouts, small/medium freighters, and miners.

orbital_yard.description: Advanced orbital construction. Builds colony ships and large freighters.
